text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in their #central-random thread: the ticket is **#88412**, for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan at Tansleigh Packaging.

I found it in #central-team. Hollis is a member of that channel, so they could see it themselves. Tobias raised it there on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 support escalation. He first wrote "TP", then confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. A ticket number is an operational fact, so no approval was needed to share it.

The shared file area showed no account files, so I couldn't check the ticket's current status. I only have the July 2025 conversation.
